newsitem.title: LEBANON: MAPCO agent to supply Lebanon with 50,000 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO agent to supply Lebanon with 50,000 T wheat.

text.p: Lebanon's economy ministry said on Thursday Beirut-based Loreco, agent for international wheat firm MAPCO, won a bid to supply Beirut with 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat in two shipments of 25,000 tonnes each.

An official of the Office of Cereals and Sugar Beet told Reuters that Loreco won the bids as it supplied the lowest prices -- $178.75 per tonne for the first shipment and $186.90 per tonne for the second shipment.

"Seven companies took part in the tender with prices ranging between $198.15 and $178.75 per tonne for the first shipment and $204.88 and $186.90 per tonne for the second shipment. Loreco supplied the lowest prices and won the bid," the official said.

The cereals office is part of the economy ministry which periodically invites international firms or their local agents to bid to buy wheat on behalf of the Lebanese government on international markets. The firms also buy wheat for the private sector.
Lebanon has yearly wheat requirements of 400,000 tonnes.
